data.title: Wall Street’s Biggest Settlement Firm Is Lining Up Stellar for 2027. Is XLM a Better Buy Than Ethereum?
data.description: Wall Street's biggest settlement firm just named Stellar as a future partner, sending XLM back onto traders' watchlists. But before you chase the catalyst, the comparison with Ethereum reveals some uncomfortable truths about timing, tokenization dominance, and price reality.
